title: Western blot, ELISA and enzymatic assays of reference proteins for subcellular fractionation
author: Saumel Perez Rodriguez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgc4jsyw
materials: Endoplasmic Reticulum Fraction Western Blot Cocktail

steps.title: Prepare PVDF Membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare the PVDF membrane for protein transfer through a series of soaking steps.

substeps.instruction: Cut the PVDF membrane to the dimensions of the polyacrylamide gel.
Soak the membrane in 100% methanol for 00:05:00 with constant agitation.
Discard methanol and soak in MilliQ water for 00:02:00 with constant agitation.
Discard water and soak in transfer buffer (20 mM Tris, 154 mM glycine, 0.08% [w/v] SDS, 20% [v/v] methanol) for 00:05:00 with constant agitation.

steps.title: Prepare Polyacrylamide Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare the gel for transfer after electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Remove the polyacrylamide gel from the electrophoresis chamber.
Rinse the gel 3 times with MilliQ water to remove excess salts and detergents.
Soak the gel in transfer buffer for 00:05:00 with constant agitation.

steps.title: Perform Protein Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to the membrane using a semi-dry system.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the transfer cassette according to the Trans-Blot SD Semi-Dry Transfer Cell (Bio-Rad, 1703940) manual.
Perform the transfer at 20 V for 30-60 min, depending on protein size and equipment performance.

steps.title: Verify Transfer and Clean Membrane
steps.instruction: Optional verification of protein transfer and subsequent cleaning of the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Wet the membrane in Ponceau staining (0.5% [w/v] Ponceau S, 1% [v/v] acetic acid) with constant agitation until protein bands are detected.
Rinse the membrane 3 times with MilliQ water to remove excess Ponceau staining.
Destain with Tris-Glycine pH 8.3 (25 mM Tris, 192 mM Glycine, 0.1% [w/v] SDS) until staining disappears.
Rinse the membrane 3 times with MilliQ water to remove excess detergent.

steps.title: Store Membrane
steps.instruction: Store the membrane in phosphate buffer (137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 8.1 mM Na2HPO4, 1.8 mM KH2PO4) at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: ER Fraction Western Blot Assay
steps.instruction: Perform Western blot specifically for the Endoplasmic Reticulum fraction.

substeps.instruction: Block the membrane in 5% (w/v) skimmed milk, 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with constant agitation.

Incubate the membrane with Endoplasmic Reticulum Fraction Western Blot Cocktail (Abcam), diluted 2000 times in 0.5% (w/v) BSA, 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with constant agitation.
Wash the membrane 3 times in 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 00:10:00 per wash with constant agitation.

Incubate the membrane with horseradish peroxidase (HRP) Conjugated Secondary Antibody Cocktail (Abcam), diluted 2500-fold in 0.5% (w/v) BSA, 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with constant agitation.
Wash the membrane 3 times in 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 00:10:00 per wash with constant agitation.

steps.title: Develop and Image Western Blot
steps.instruction: Visualize the proteins on the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Wash the membrane in phosphate buffer for 00:05:00.
Wet the membrane in a 1:1 (v/v) mix of Luminol/Enhancer Solution and Stable Peroxide Solution (SuperSignal West Pico Chemiluminescent Substrate kit, Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Acquire the image using a LI-COR C-DiGit Chemiluminescence Western Blot Scanner (Image Studio software, high sensitivity mode), X-ray films, or a CCD camera-based digital imaging instrument.

steps.title: General Reference Protein Western Blot
steps.instruction: Perform Western blot for other reference proteins (golgin-97, flotilin 1, Hsp60, golgin A5).

substeps.instruction: Block the membrane in 3% skimmed milk, 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20 in TBS (137 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.6) for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with constant agitation.

Incubate the membrane overnight at 4 °C with constant agitation using the corresponding primary antibody diluted in 3% skimmed milk, 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20 in TBS. Dilutions: anti golgin-97 (GTX114445) 2,000x, anti flotilin 1 (GTX104769) 2,000x, anti Hsp60 (GTX110089) 10,000x, and anti golgin A5 (GTX104255) 2,000x.
Wash the membrane 3 times in 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20 in TBS. Wash for 00:05:00 per wash, except for anti Hsp60 and anti golgin A5, which require 00:10:00 per wash.

Incubate the membrane with anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to HRP (or other HRP-conjugated anti-rabbit secondary antibody) diluted 2000 times in 3% skimmed milk, 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20 in TBS for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with constant agitation.
Wash the membrane 3 times in 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20 in TBS for 00:05:00 per wash.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA Homogenates
steps.instruction: Prepare positive and negative control homogenates.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge CHO cells (CRL-12444) at 185 x g, 4 °C, 5 minutes and E. coli cells (ATCC 53606) at 8161 x g, 4 °C, 10 minutes.
Wash cell pellets twice in phosphate buffer (137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 8.1 mM Na2HPO4, 1.8 mM KH2PO4).
Lyse cells by solubilization in IEF buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 2% [w/v] CHAPS, 40 mM dithiothreitol) supplemented with 10% (v/v) SigmaFast Protease Inhibitor Cocktail.
Sonicate lysates twice for 00:01:00 at 10 µm.
Centrifuge at 16000 x g, 4 °C, 25 minutes and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Perform ELISA Assay
steps.instruction: Conduct ELISA for protein detection using high binding plates.

substeps.instruction: Coat ELISA high binding plates (Greiner Bio-One) with 4 µg of E. coli ATCC 53606, CRL-12444 cell homogenates, and differential centrifugation samples, all diluted in 200 µL of 0.050 M sodium carbonate-bicarbonate buffer (pH 9.6) for 16:00:00 at 4 °C.
Block plates with 200 µL of 1% (w/v) BSA and 0.05% Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 01:00:00 at Room temperature.
Wash plates 5 times with 200 µL per well of 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer at Room temperature.
Incubate plates with anti golgin-97 antibody (GTX114445) diluted 2000-fold in 1% (w/v) BSA and 0.05% Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 02:00:00 at Room temperature (100 µL per well).
Wash plates 5 times with 200 µL per well of 0.05% (v/v) Tween-20 in phosphate buffer.
Incubate plates with anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to HRP diluted 1000 times in 1% (w/v) BSA and 0.05% Tween-20 in phosphate buffer for 01:30:00 at Room temperature (100 µL per well).
Add 100 µL per well of SigmaFast o-phenylenediamine dihydrochloride (OPD) substrate and incubate for 00:15:00 at Room temperature.
Stop the reaction by adding 50 µL of 10% (v/v) HCl per well.

steps.title: Catalase Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Measure catalase activity in sucrose gradient fractions.

substeps.instruction: Mix 20 µL of each fraction with 30 µL of 50 mM phosphate buffer (21 mM KH2PO4, 29 mM K2HPO4), pH 7.0, and 50 µL of 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 in a 12x75 mm glass test tube.
Add 50 µL of 30% (v/v) hydrogen peroxide to each tube and mix.
Incubate for 00:05:00 and measure the height of the foam column.
Calculate specific activity (mm/mg) as the ratio between foam height (mm) and protein quantity added (mg).
